assets.title: Chambered Fossil Section
assets.description: Original stylized spiral-shell fossil section with a thick irregular stone matrix and broad directly grounded cut bottom. A continuous expanding solid shell wall and 22 separate thick curved septa bound a sequence of genuinely recessed chambers. The pale planar shell faces, darker chamber floors and rough faceted outer rind are actual closed meshes with solid PBR materials; no image, procedural texture or painted fossil pattern is used. The shell walls project 0.15 m above the recessed stone floor and are embedded into the matrix. Metres, Z-up native source, front facing -Y. Named editable parts and self-contained generator. This single specimen differs from the existing five-prism crystal cluster and unsectioned raw minerals. Static artistic collection prop; no real species identification, scientific anatomical reconstruction, dating, geological accuracy, physical conservation, load, stability or safety certification.
